data.narrative:
Fleet Space Technologies, a Series C stage space & aerospace company that has raised $70M+, was valued using two applicable triangulation methods against a peer universe of 3 private comparables at the same stage and sector (Sierra Space, Varda Space Industries, Skyryse) and 5 public space & aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $70M total raised as a valuation proxy, implying $119M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-stage, same-sector private comparables yields a median valuation of $1.5B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue data. The peer-median method reflects substantial dispersion driven by Sierra Space's $8.0B valuation relative to the $1.1B–$1.5B cluster of other comparables.

The triangulated analysis across both applicable methods supports a valuation range of $101M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $810M. Key uncertainties include: the wide dispersion in peer valuations, Fleet Space's relative positioning within the sector, revenue traction and unit economics not visible from available data, and whether stage-progression from total raised represents an appropriate methodology in a sector where comparable multiples vary by 7x. The peer-median result dominates the range but warrants scrutiny given the outlier position of Sierra Space.
